title: A high-impact social media post graphic for the iOS calendar and productivity app 'Pencil'd'. Dark midnight navy theme (#101127) with luminous neon orange (#ff7a00), coral (#ff5277), and purple/violet accents. Bold typographic headline: 'Turn Any Schedule Into Calendar Events Instantly'. Featuring a sleek 3D rendered calendar notebook icon with a glowing gradient pencil and floating UI elements showing automated schedule scanning, neural OCR, and iOS calendar sync badges. Clean, modern, highly engaging for Instagram and Twitter, polished Apple-like marketing presentation.
